description: This Java source file defines the 'RequirementServices' class, providing multiple service methods related to order requirements within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functions for fetching requirements for suppliers, creating requirements based on orders, generating ATP requirements, and updating requirement statuses, mainly for order and inventory management.

classes.name: RequirementServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for managing order requirements, including retrieval, creation, and updating of requirements in the OFBiz system.

methods.name: getRequirementsForSupplier
methods.description: Fetches requirements for a specified supplier or unassigned requirements, applying various filters and aggregating data such as total quantities, amounts, and associated product info.

methods.name: createAutoRequirementsForOrder
methods.description: Automatically creates requirements for an order based on products' requirement method and order quantities, linking requirements to order items.

methods.name: createATPRequirementsForOrder
methods.description: Generates ATP (Available To Promise) requirements for order items when stock levels fall below minimum thresholds, considering current inventory and pending requirements.

methods.name: updateRequirementsToOrdered
methods.description: Updates requirements associated with an order to the 'REQ_ORDERED' status, indicating they have been officially ordered.
